tool_schemas.name: get_sitemap_tree
tool_schemas.description: Returns the persisted sitemap index/tree for the given site, optionally scoped to a specific root_sitemap_id, and can include URL/page nodes when include_urls=true; max_depth limits how many levels from the root are returned (0 returns only the root). This endpoint is not paged (it returns a single tree snapshot). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id/root_sitemap_id formats are invalid or max_depth is negative, NOT_FOUND if the site does not exist or the specified root_sitemap_id is not present for that site, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site to fetch the sitemap tree for.

root_sitemap_id.description: Optional root sitemap ID to scope the returned tree to a specific sitemap crawl.

include_urls.description: Whether to include URL/page nodes in the returned tree (if false, only sitemap nodes are returned).

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of nodes to return from the root (0 returns only the root).

tool_schemas.name: get_sitemap_pages
tool_schemas.description: Get all pages from a website's sitemap with optional limits and filtering options. Supports cursor-based pagination.

site_id.description: ID of the site whose sitemap pages should be listed.

sitemap_id.description: Optional sitemap ID to restrict results to pages discovered in a specific sitemap.

path_prefix.description: Filter pages whose parsed URL path starts with this prefix (e.g. "/blog").

url_contains.description: Filter pages whose full URL contains this substring.

discovered_after.description: Only return pages discovered at or after this timestamp.

discovered_before.description: Only return pages discovered at or before this timestamp.

lastmod_after.description: Only return pages with lastmod at or after this timestamp.

lastmod_before.description: Only return pages with lastmod at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_sitemap_stats
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns aggregate statistics for a site’s stored sitemap structure (and, when provided, only the subtree rooted at root_sitemap_id), such as counts of sitemap nodes and extracted URL pages. This endpoint is not paged and returns a single stats object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the site (or scoped root_sitemap_id for that site) does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site to compute sitemap statistics for.

root_sitemap_id.description: Optional root sitemap ID to scope statistics to a specific sitemap crawl.

tool_schemas.name: parse_sitemap_content
tool_schemas.description: Parses the provided sitemap XML/text content, associates it with the given site (and optionally source_url and parent_sitemap_id), persists the sitemap node, updates sitemap index relationships, and extracts/stores individual URL pages discovered in the content. Returns the ingested sitemap record (including its assigned sitemap ID) plus parse/ingest results such as discovered child sitemaps and URL counts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs are malformed, parent_sitemap_id is invalid for the site, or the content cannot be parsed as a supported sitemap format; NOT_FOUND if the site (or specified parent_sitemap_id) does not exist; CONFLICT if the ingest would create an invalid sitemap relationship (e.g., cycles) or violates uniqueness rules for the same sitemap under the same site; and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller lacks access or has exceeded ingest limits for the site.

site_id.description: ID of the site the sitemap belongs to.

content.description: Raw sitemap XML/text content to parse and ingest.

source_url.description: Optional URL the content was fetched from (used for provenance and resolving sitemap relationships).

parent_sitemap_id.description: Optional parent sitemap ID when this sitemap was discovered from a sitemap index.

tool_schemas.name: list_sites
tool_schemas.description: Lists sites visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status/host and paginated. Returns a stable, cursor-paged list ordered by created_at then id; refuses invalid filters with VALIDATION_ERROR.

canonical_url_contains.description: Filter sites whose canonical_url contains this substring.

limit.description: Maximum number of sites to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create_site
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new site record for a canonical URL/host and optional robots.txt URL. Returns the created site. Refuses malformed or non-http(s) URLs with VALIDATION_ERROR, and may refuse duplicates (same host) with CONFLICT depending on deployment policy.

canonical_url.description: Canonical base URL for the site (must be http or https).

host.description: Host for the site (e.g. "example.com"); if omitted, derived from canonical_url.

robots_txt_url.description: Optional robots.txt URL for the site (must be http or https).

tool_schemas.name: update_site
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a site, including lifecycle status transitions. Returns the updated site. Refuses invalid identifiers (VALIDATION_ERROR), missing sites (NOT_FOUND), and illegal status transitions (CONFLICT).

site_id.description: ID of the site to update.

canonical_url.description: Updated canonical base URL (must be http or https).

robots_txt_url.description: Updated robots.txt URL (must be http or https).

status.description: New site status; must follow lifecycle transitions (active<->disabled, active/disabled->deleted).

tool_schemas.name: get_parse_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single parse job by ID. Returns the job record including status, timestamps, result_sitemap_id (when succeeded), and error fields (when failed). Refuses malformed IDs (VALIDATION_ERROR) and returns NOT_FOUND when absent.

parse_job_id.description: ID of the parse job to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update_parse_job
tool_schemas.description: Updates a parse job to drive allowed lifecycle transitions (e.g. queued->cancelled, failed->queued). Returns the updated job. Refuses illegal transitions (CONFLICT), updates to finished jobs (CONFLICT), and invalid IDs (VALIDATION_ERROR).

parse_job_id.description: ID of the parse job to update.

status.description: New job status; must follow lifecycle transitions. Typical client-driven transitions: queued->cancelled and failed/cancelled->queued.
